verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents support for 130+ file formats through a single parse call on one API key and SDK. The docs explicitly name PDFs, scans, Office files, images and spreadsheets/Excel, so a mixed document set goes through one endpoint without per-format code. missing for 10: explicit per-format confirmation of HTML, email (EML/MSG), DOCX and PPTX in the evidence (only implied by "Office files" and "130+ formats"), and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.
